description: Per-module disposition registry for the wired-but-dead pub mods allowlisted in scripts/check_orphan_modules.py::WIRED_BUT_DEAD (Issue #3748). Every allowlist entry must carry exactly one row with an owner-assigned wire-or-delete decision; the registry must stay in lock-step with the live wired-but-dead set. Resolving a module (wiring it up or deleting it) requires dropping its row AND lowering BASELINE_WIRED_BUT_DEAD by one in the same PR.

modules.rationale: EnergyPlus-parity EMS framework (sensors/actuators/programs); parked until the simulation loop integrates it. Decision documented in src/sim/ems.rs.
Design-day HVAC sizing utility; parked until a CLI or reporting consumer exists. Decision documented in src/sim/hvac_sizing.rs.
Assembly-variant validation library; wire into the validation suite or delete in the #3748 burn-down.
Dynamic ONNX batching for surrogate throughput; wire into an ort-feature consumer or delete.
Performance measurement utilities; benches/ is excluded from caller scope by design, so wire a production consumer or delete.
Quantum state-space parameter initializer; wire into the quantum path or delete.
Implicit multi-zone ODE solver reserved as an alternative integration path; wire into a consumer or delete.
Distributed inference scaffold; wire into a multi-node consumer or delete.
DOE Commercial Reference Building configurations; wire into the validation suite or delete.
epJSON (EnergyPlus JSON) parser; wire into an input-format consumer or delete.
Fault detection and diagnostics surface; wire into validation/twin reporting or delete.
FLEXLAB measured-weather loader; wire into the empirical validation datasets or delete.
Inter-zone conductance functions; wire into a multi-zone coupling consumer or delete.
Parallel execution infrastructure; wire into a population-scale batch path or delete (BatchOracle remains the only sanctioned parallelism).
Reduced-order-model intermediary fidelity layer; wire into a multi-zone consumer or delete.
Monte Carlo sweep infrastructure for Phase 2 ML data generation (#1776); wire a driver or delete.
Test-helper surface for tests/<subdir>/ harnesses, which are not Cargo targets and are excluded from caller scope by design.
TOPSIS multi-criteria selection for Pareto optimization; wire into an optimization consumer or delete.
Diagnostic heuristics for SystematicIssue::Unknown ASHRAE failures; wire into the issue classifier or delete.
